The project is a scaffold: conventions and guardrails exist, application code does not.\n\n2. **There is no test surface.** No test file, no runner configuration, no `[verify]` block in `policy.toml` (the block is documented there but left commented out). The one line present cannot fail, so this is absence of coverage by construction rather than working-but-untested code.
